facts.text: Mining share in GSDP: 3.53% (2018–19) → 2.71% (2023–24); 2022 auction-only rule stalled applications

facts.text: Reform: Pending applications; Detail: over 6,000 revived — first-come first-served; LOI within 1 year
facts.head: Key reforms

facts.text: Reform: Dual grant; Detail: application-based for minor minerals (building material, granite); auction-based for industrial minerals
facts.head: Key reforms

facts.text: Reform: Lease premium; Detail: cut from 10x to 5x dead rent; limestone slabs 3x
facts.head: Key reforms

facts.text: Reform: Lease period; Detail: granite and industrial minerals 20 → 30 years; road metal (captive) 15 → 30 years
facts.head: Key reforms

facts.text: Reform: 'Consideration Amount'; Detail: abolished (introduced during COVID)
facts.head: Key reforms

facts.text: Reform: OTS scheme; Detail: rationalised penalties; closure of abandoned leases
facts.head: Key reforms

facts.text: Tech: digital lease lifecycle; drone and CCTV surveillance
facts.head: Key reforms
